speaker: Doctor
text: That is highly unusual given the clear mass on the CT scan; could you clarify if the biopsy failed to retrieve tissue or if the result was truly negative for malignancy? I need to know if there was any mention of inflammation or infection in the biopsy report.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the patient's significant weight loss, heavy smoking history, and the persistent right apical lung mass on CT despite negative biopsies and normal MRI of the brachial plexus, I suspect a primary lung malignancy that may have been missed by the initial biopsy due to sampling error or necrosis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Pancoast Tumor (Superior Sulcus Tumor)
